subject: Difference in a valid number of hours between day summaries from parts 2 and 5

messages.author: 33a987d6141d8d65
messages.subject: Difference in a valid number of hours between day summaries from parts 2 and 5
parts:
Hi Everyone,


I have quite a striking discrepancy in a valid number of hours per day between the outputs from parts 2 and 5 (day summaries) for some days. Please find attached the comparison for 3 subjects.


I am not sure why the discrepancy occurs and have not found an answer in previous discussions related to wear time. A related post by John “Difference in non-wear hours estimates between Part5 Day Summary and Person Summary output” reported on the differences between the valid number of hours between outputs from part 5 (day and person summaries). 


However, my concern pertains to the differences in the number of valid hours between parts 2 and 5-day summaries. I am using midnight to midnight window


Has anyone experienced a similar issue and would be happy to share what worked for them?


Attached is my code for reference.


Thank you in advance!


Best wishes,


Dominika

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Difference in a valid number of hours between day summaries from parts 2 and 5
parts:
See my other response from half an hour ago: Definitions of valid days between part 2 and part 5 can differ, because part 5 has criteria for both night (noon-noon) and daytime (midnight-midnight), while part2 only requires sufficient weartime during the day (midnight-midnight).
Vincent

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Difference in a valid number of hours between day summaries from parts 2 and 5
parts:
Hi Vincent, 

 

Thank you for your comprehensive responses to my questions regarding ENMO metrics.

 

In relation to the difference in nonwear time between day summary reports from parts 2 and 5, your response to the other post does not explain why the differences in the number of nonwear hours are striking for some subjects (please see the spreadsheet). For example, in part 2 day summary for subject #301 for day 4/9/2018, nonwear is reported as 24 hours. In part 5 day summary for the same subject and day, the number of valid hours is reported as 24 hours. I used MM. Empty spaces under part 5 indicate the lack of data for that day in part 5 relative to part 2. The discrepancies are highlighted.

 

In part 2 of the code, I defined a valid day as at least 16 hours of wear.

 

As there is no specific criterion provided for part 5, and vignette advises that the settings from part 2 are re-used in part 5 for calculation of sleep and physical activity data, I computed a criterion variable (Valid day), using a threshold of less than 33% of nonweartime (explicitly: “nonwear_perc_day” < 33) within a 24hr (midnight-to-midnight), which roughly corresponds to 16 hours criterion from part 5 (minus the decimal 0.3333. I would like to understand why in part 2 all hours would be considered valid while the opposite is the case in part 5 day summary report for some days?

 

I attached the spreadsheet and my code for reference.

 

Thank you in advance!

 

Best,

 

Dominika
